title: Structural code search and rewrite
requirement: Search and rewrite code by syntax-tree pattern from the command line, or establish that symbol navigation and text search already cover the need.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Precision and recall on a fixed set of structural queries against text search and symbol tools, and the tokens an agent spends per answered query.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
